Only downloads image assets when asset_types filter is set

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { AssetCategory, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { assetTypes: [AssetCategory.Image], downloadAssets: true };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
  console.log(result.assets?.length);
  console.log(result.assets?.[0]?.assetCategory);
}

void main();
```
